description: This PHP class defines LDAP Employee Selector Mapping for the OrangeHRM system, handling LDAP attribute mappings, conversions, and extraction of employee data from LDAP entries.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping
classes.description: A class extending ParameterBag to facilitate LDAP employee attribute mapping, validation, and extraction.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all stored LDAP employee selector mappings as an array.

methods.name: getAllAttributeNames
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute names from the LDAP employee selector mappings.

methods.name: extractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Extracts attribute values from an LDAP entry to populate an LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams object based on current mappings.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Factory method to create an LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping instance from an array of mapping definitions, with validation.
